text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- About 400,000 university students resume academic year.
- President Liamine Zeroual takes part in economic debates at a five-day national conference on development.

- Former ruling National Liberation Front (FLN) holds a policy-making central committee meeting. FLN's reform-wing leader Mouloud Hamrouche to stay away from the meeting to protest against the party leadership policy seen as too close to the government.
- Air Algerie pilots appeal to Zeroual to intervene to end their row with the company board over wage hike and dismissal of some pilots.

- The Transitional National Council, government-appointed quasi-parliament, starts session to vote several laws, including privatisation and election legislations, and adopt the state budget for 1997.
